Game Overview

In Combat Battle, the core idea is straightforward: survive relentless waves of monsters in the high-stakes adrenaline rush of Combat Battle. Precise shooting and strategic movement are your keys to victory as you fend off threats from all sides. Every pinpoint shot and evasive move counts toward outscoring your foes in this dynamic, heart-pounding struggle for survival.
